verses.1: Jehovah reigneth; he is clothed with majesty; Jehovah is clothed with strength; he hath girded himself therewith: The world also is established, that it cannot be moved.
verses.2: Thy throne is established of old: Thou art from everlasting.
verses.3: The floods have lifted up, O Jehovah, The floods have lifted up their voice; The floods lift up their waves.
verses.4: Above the voices of many waters, The mighty breakers of the sea, Jehovah on high is mighty.
verses.5: Thy testimonies are very sure: Holiness becometh thy house, O Jehovah, for evermore.

metadata.source: Derived from the American Standard Version (1901), revised for the ABIDE Bible App.
